Subject: Advocate intros request: NovaMed (EU healthcare)

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

We have a late-stage opportunity with NovaMed (deal attached) — they’re a clinical imaging SaaS based in Berlin evaluating Redwood for a private / VPC deployment to support PHI and EU data residency. Procurement is asking for 1-2 customer references in EU healthcare that have done a private or on-prem installation and can speak to audit logging / SOC2 + network architecture.

Context:
- Deal: DEAL-2026-0427 (attached deal_summary.pdf)
- Timeline: procurement decision targeted by 6/18; they want reference calls next week if possible
- Personas on call: Head of ML (Anna), Security/Compliance lead, Procurement (Peter)
- Must-have: an example of a customer who deployed Redwood Private / dedicated pool in EU and has an incident/audit playbook we can reference

Please suggest 1-2 advocates (EU healthcare or regulated health-tech) who are comfortable with a short 30-min engineering/security-focused call. If anyone is open to a brief recorded testimonial that’d be a plus.

Also attaching our mutual action plan link for the deal.

Thanks — Rafael

- Availability: Tue 6/9 09:00-11:00 CET or Wed 6/10 14:00-16:00 CET.
- Notes: Comfortable on short engineering/security calls; agreed to speak on background.

2) Medora Labs (DE) — Contact: Pierre Dubois (VP Eng) <pierre.dubois@medora-labs.de>

- Availability: Thu 6/11 morning CET.
- Notes: Open to recorded testimonial but prefers approval of final cut.

I can make intros and manage scheduling + DocuSign NDA if needed (we have a template). I’ve added proposed times in the body — pick the one you want me to lock in and I’ll coordinate.

HubSpot: 53729 (NovaMed)
